news.title: Tillis backs Whatley in North Carolina Senate race
news.summary: Sen. Thom Tillis (R-N.C.) is backing Republican candidate Michael Whatley for the Senate seat he’s leaving behind — his first public declaration of who he will support. Whatley is in a tight race against former Gov. Roy Cooper (D), who is currently favored to win. Tillis told NewsNation, The Hill’s sister network, on Tuesday that…
